description: This file defines the main application component for a React-based web app. It manages routing between different pages such as Home, Chat, Story, Profile, Search, and Notifications, using context hooks for user authentication and current page state. It also includes an authentication gate that renders either the app or a login page based on user status.

methods.name: AppContent
methods.description: Main content component that renders different pages based on the current page state and context.

methods.name: renderPage
methods.description: Function that selects and returns the appropriate page component based on the current application state.

methods.name: AuthGate
methods.description: Component controlling whether to show the app content or the authentication page based on user login status.
